_comment: The one hand-maintained input of tools/build-readme-overview. Creator rows (aliases are matched case-insensitively against a recipe's source owner and attribution) and family rules (recipe slug prefixes, first match wins; unmatched recipes fall back to their Model's family title). Everything else in the README overview is generated.
